name: Project Manager
quote: Akmad delivered the HRIS and POS systems on time and exactly as specified. What impressed us most was his ability to understand our business process quickly and translate it into a working system. The HRIS alone saved our HR team hours of manual work every month.

name: Owner
quote: The POS system he built for both our restaurants has been running for over 2 years without major issues. He understood the restaurant workflow well and the system is easy for our staff to use. Maintenance has been minimal — which is exactly what we needed.
